input_pdb.description: Input PDB file path for existing binder (chain A) + target complex

hotspot_residues.description: Hotspot residues on target chain(s) for binder redesign. Chain identifier is required for BoltzGen modes. Use null for no hotspots

bg_not_binding_residues.description: Target residues the binder should NOT contact. Use null for none

bg_redesign_spec.description: Chain A (binder) architecture spec: ordered comma-separated list of chain-A 'keep' tokens (e.g. 'A10-50' or 'A60') and bare-digit 'insert' tokens (e.g. '10' or '7-10'). Any original chain A residue not covered by a keep token is deleted. Use null to leave architecture (length) unchanged

bg_redesign_inpaint_seq.description: Chain A (binder) residues, within those kept by bg_redesign_spec, whose sequence is allowed to change while structure stays fixed. Use null for none

bg_flexible_residues.description: Residues whose structure should NOT be conditioned on (useful for disordered/flexible regions). May reference chain A residues kept by bg_redesign_spec. Use null for none
